local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frames=0
local droppedElapsed=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if not core.isWorldPaused() and Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x024569))==0 then droppedElapsed=droppedElapsed+dt end
 if droppedElapsed>=3 then print('SongDrop three simulation seconds after full-stack drop') end
 frames=frames+1;if frames<60 or frames%15~=0 then return end
 for _,obj in ipairs(Actor.inventory(self):getAll()) do if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x024569) then local rec=types.Book.record(obj);assert(rec.name=='A Less Rude Song' and rec.weight==0.5 and rec.value==6,'Original Song properties changed');print('SongDrop original properties value=6 weight=0.5') end end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died testing genuine Song drop')
 print('SongDrop stock='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x024569))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' nirnroot='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4e940))..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
 for _,o in ipairs(nearby.items) do
  if tostring(o.recordId)==tostring(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x024569)) then assert(not types.Book.objectIsInstance(o),'Song world drop must have native identity');print('SongDrop nearby id='..o.id..' base='..tostring(o.recordId)..' position='..tostring(o.position)) end
 end
end}}}}
